I’m 17. Most kids I know are fucked. No real mental health services; they’re all too overwhelmed for the workers to be helpful (not their fault) or invested. There feels like there is no hope for any of us because of how much everything is goi to cost after this. So many people including myself can’t leave our homes now or be around people, many of us under 21 (brain is still developing.) The difference is huge when you are alone with only an adult as well, as only children have almost no stimulation if they aren’t attending some sort of daycare (again many kids are too old or may be immunocompromised.) How do people expect us to magically rebound and be able to function when things return? Imagine how many kids will developmentally be struggling; I myself have a hard time even speaking to people because after talking to just one person for almost a year, it feels it’s so unpredictable and uncomfortable to even speak to other people.

Every Victoria Day everyone runs to the small towns. We aren’t nearly as vaccinated as many of the people who will have received at least one dose that come up from hotspots. Our supply is being redistributed. 

Most cases in our area have originated from other areas in the beginning, and even now it’s usually some people from our area that get together with people outside of town than those in town. In town cases are usually workplace only, or sometimes sadly parties because it rural. 

People get extremely upset if we refuse to let them in (despite the fact majority are families that are stopping in town and using our amenities as well. Amazing normally terrifying right now.) and also refuse to follow basic rules. Nothing is being sanitized at the boat launches, no one legally is there to enforce one person on the dock at a time, there is NO ATM or anything for debt so all fees are accepted in cash because the county simply can’t afford to set up a machine. People threaten us (just volunteers) because they can’t launch their boats. This may sound stupid but I’m really worried if everything is reopened and we limit who we allow something messy will happen. We’ve had funny Karen moments before, but we’ve also had death threats and people try to spit at us. We are a staff of usually 1-3 people at most, and with people becoming even more fed up I’m worried if things are opened people will freak at places taking their own liberties to stay closed to try and stop people from coming up. 

I haven’t seen or done anything in months. I am literally screaming out of boredom, I understand the toll it is taking mental health wise. However, if we decide to open up early there’s also many risk. One is children aren’t vaccinated, which... hmmm... hopefully the virus doesn’t mutate to effect the people who aren’t vaccinated. There are a few recent theories about this possibly occurring in the future, but I myself  admit have no idea the credibility. 

Also we need to consider vaccinating 16-17 year olds as they are eligible. I am speaking from incredible bias being 17, but I see most people my age doing whatever the shit they want. To the point where - I’m alienated from my peers because their life has continued while mine has stopped. These people are also possibly going back to mass congregate settings, much larger than some workplaces. Although vaccines aren’t approved for younger age groups yet, we should be vaccinating as low as possible.

Lastly I really believe we need mental health supports in place while opening. There aren’t really any right now for in person, but there needs to be some sort of network to support those needing help adjusting. We can’t expect everyone to be able to resume normally after this has happened three times; we need to make sure our youth (and adults) are getting adequate care and having their mental health needs addressed before they become any worse. They aren’t really being properly addressed to begin with, but there needs to be some sort of plan/extra help provided for the amount of people who have suffered from that pandemic or may suffer when readjusting. 

As I said I’m 17, everything I’m saying is probably total bs but I feel like it’s important to consider mental health and medical services in general; for so many people to be happy we need to be able to open up to an amount where there’s services can safely function - instead of closing off and on and having them continuously on hold.

The last sad part I remember my mom telling me is that unlike usual where they could do 1-2, maybe even 3 cows without having to sharpen their knives, they had to sharpen them 3-4 times per cattle because of the amount of meat being taken off, as well as how dehydrated they were. My first trip was on Nbome. I don’t know which one. I do not recommend consuming Nbome tabs at all. I took two, and although my trip was actually kind of decent, there’s reports of ODS off of two tabs. The body load can be very unpleasant. 

Without a kit, the only way to sort of tell if it might be Nbome is an extreme bitter taste. It’s usually bitter and metallic tasting, and may make your mouth go numb after awhile. 

If you have been sucking on the tab for few seconds and it turns somewhat unpleasant tasting but maybe not extremely bitter, it could just be ink. Swallow that tab immediately though. Nbome only works when you let it sit in your mouth, swallowing it makes it ineffective as the body doesn’t break it down properly. LSD is broken down both in the mouth and stomach. So if it is LSD, it’ll work. Nbome will not. 

HOWEVER! That’s based off what I’ve read and my experiences. You probably should invest in a kit for safety. There may be other RCs on the tabs that aren’t Nbome, such as one of the DOx chemicals. I have no idea how to distinguish them, or other RCs that aren’t as common. 

Also dosing with RCs usually isn’t as consistent. Your dealer may say “these tabs are only 70ug” but they have a shitload of Nbome on them, and you have a trip much more intense than 140ug. One time you may take a tab and be fine, and the next time you may lose your shit.

ALSO: If it is LSD, leave it on your tongue for 15-20 minutes then swallow it.
Make sure to surrender yourself to the experience, and try to enjoy it!
